verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training policy or opt-out. The user can only keep data away from model training indirectly: OpenCode runs against 75+ providers including local models, users bring their own API keys, and enterprise config can force all traffic through an internal AI gateway. A community report says OpenCode sends telemetry to its own servers even with local models and offers no way to disable it, which weakens the privacy posture but does not address training specifically. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party policy that user code/prompts are not used for training, a documented training opt-out (including for OpenCode Zen), a telemetry disable control, independent corroboration.
